sub_answers.sub_question: What documented factional disputes or leadership challenges have occurred within Welsh Labour in the past twenty years?
sub_answers.text: Welsh Labour has faced repeated leadership upheavals, with the Welsh Labour leadership election held in 2026 after First Minister Eluned Morgan failed to win her seat and resigned on 8 May 2026. [d83134346s0p0] The 2026 leadership election was the party’s fourth leader in just over two years, after Vaughan Gething and Mark Drakeford. [d83134346s0p0] The Gething government ended in July 2024 following two distinct scandals involving allegations of cronyism and allegations Gething lied about deleting COVID-19 text messages. [d68245236s1p0]

sub_answers.sub_question: How have tensions between trade unions, party membership, and parliamentary representatives manifested in Welsh Labour decisions?
What criticisms or limitations have been raised about Welsh Labour's handling of national identity and relations with Plaid Cymru?
What electoral or structural constraints (e.g., voting system, demographic shifts) threaten Welsh Labour's dominance?
sub_answers.text: Welsh Labour lost government and its status as the largest party for the first time since devolution began in 1999 when it was reduced to third place with 9 seats in the 2026 Senedd election. [d68245236s0p0] The 2026 Senedd election followed reforms that increased the Senedd from 60 to 96 members, adopted party-list proportional representation, and reduced the number of constituencies to sixteen. [d68245236s0p0] The 2026 Senedd election also shortened its term from five years to four, and turnout was 51.72%. [d68245236s0p0]

sub_answers.sub_question: What major policy platforms has Welsh Labour emphasized in recent Senedd manifestos (health, education, economy, etc.)?
sub_answers.text: Welsh Labour’s 2021 Senedd manifesto emphasized health and social care, including investing in mental health services and a new medical school in North Wales. [d33580665s8p0] It emphasized education policies including tutoring staff to help pupils catch up after the pandemic, improving school facilities, and expanding access to Welsh-medium education. [d33580665s8p0] It also proposed wider commitments such as more reforestation, more social housing, and possible electoral reform for Senedd elections. [d33580665s8p0]

sub_answers.sub_question: Which Welsh Labour manifesto commitments have been highlighted in the most recent Senedd elections, specifically covering health, education, the economy, and other major policy areas?
sub_answers.text: In the 2021 Senedd election, Labour highlighted commitments to invest in mental health services and to move eventually toward free-at-point-of-use social care as part of a UK-wide reform. [d33580665s8p0] Labour also promised a new medical school in North Wales. [d33580665s8p0] For education, Labour proposed tutoring staff to help pupils catch up after the pandemic, funding to improve school facilities, expanding access to Welsh-medium education, and increasing eligibility for free school meals. [d33580665s8p0] Labour’s other highlighted plans included more reforestation, more social housing, and possible electoral reform for Senedd elections. [d33580665s8p0]
